genomes.name: Quick Dip, Trend-Assisted
genomes.thesis: One- and two-session trades. It buys a 2% drop above the 200-day mean, a close back over the 50-day, a 5.2% 20-day run while volatility is under 50%, the day after a 1% drop inside a 1.5% five-day dip above the 50-day (or any day more than 15.6% above the 200-day) when the close is not stretched above its 20-day mean, and a close through the upper Bollinger band. It sells after two sessions, on the first 0.5% up day, or on a close 1.8% under the 20-day mean; 3.5% stop.

entry_rules.when: ret1 <= -0.02 and close > sma200 or cross_above(close, sma50)
(prev(ret1) < -0.01 and ret5 < -0.015 and close > sma50 or dist_sma200 > 0.156) and zscore20 < 0.58
